Tree & hedge work

Blue Fox Landscape & Services provides local, professional tree removal services in Lake Mary, FL, and the surrounding areas.

Free estimatesResidential & commercialLake Mary & Central FL
Get a free quote Call 407-717-8191

What this is

Tree & hedge work in Lake Mary and the surrounding areas.

Our professional tree removal experts will remove your trees and stumps, leaving your property looking great. We also offer tree and hedge trimming to give your trees and hedges a neat, uniform look.

In Central Florida the tree question is rarely only about the tree. It is about what the roots are doing to a driveway, what the canopy is dropping on a roof and into the gutters, and how the whole thing will behave in a storm. We look at all of it while we are there.

What's involved

How it works, and what shapes the quote.

Residential and commercial, across Lake Mary, Heathrow, Altamonte Springs, Longwood and Orlando.

01

Tree removal

Taken down and taken away, with the property left tidy.

02

Stump removal

Say whether you want the stump gone, and it is written into the scope rather than assumed.

03

Tree and hedge trimming

A neat, uniform look — and, near the house, less debris on the roof and in the gutters.

What affects the scope

  • Height and spread of the tree
  • How close it is to the house, fences or power lines
  • Whether the stump comes out too
  • Hedge length and height for trimming
  • Access for equipment and debris removal
  • What is planted underneath

Every quote is based on the property itself — the estimate visit is where the measuring happens, and it is free.

Questions

Before you call.

Is stump removal included in tree removal?

Our tree removal experts remove trees and stumps — but the scope on your specific quote is what governs, so it should say so explicitly either way.

Do you trim hedges as well as trees?

Yes. We offer tree and hedge trimming to give your trees and hedges a neat, uniform look.

Is the quote free?

Yes — free and no-obligation for tree trimming or removal.
